Bidding above 31 risks negative profit if I win and the second price exceeds my value; bidding below 31 can forfeit positive-profit wins. No past rounds to exploit, so bid my value to maximize expected long-run profit.]

[Bid my true value of $37. In a second-price auction, bidding truthfully is a dominant strategy: I win iff the second-highest bid < 37 and then pay that bid, yielding value − price ≥ 0. Overbidding risks paying more than my value; underbidding loses positive-profit wins. No prior history to adjust for.]
